scores.label: Scoped WSG audit score
scores.formula: 100 * passed / (passed + failed + cantTell), grouped once per guideline

impactWeighted.status: Experimental project convention using WSG impact priority points; not a W3C site score

scores.interpretation: Passes satisfy only the declared scoped expectations; unknowns earn no points but are not defects. Compare only matching rubric, sample, and evidence profiles.

guidelines.title: Identify, assess, disclose, review, and mitigate sustainability impacts
guidelines.expectation: A retrieved public sustainability statement identifies the audited service and describes its impacts and mitigation. Judge disclosure only, not execution; an unresolved relationship is cantTell.

judgments.rationale: Creating a greener website explicitly identifies tate.org.uk, explains device/server/production impacts and lists mitigation including CMS change, removing video banners/GIFs, improving image delivery, editor guidance and code/data refinements. This meets the disclosure expectation despite the automatic common-path discovery missing it. Execution and estimate verification are separate.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Understand user requirements or constraints
Integrate sustainability into every stage of the ideation process
Design efficient and streamlined user journeys
guidelines.expectation: Execute declared task actions and inspect completion evidence; an expected selector is one observable, not proof of user success or optimal journey length.

judgments.rationale: The homepage Tate Modern card and Accessibility section are activated, and the resulting readable page includes twelve disabled parking spaces via Park Street plus advance phone/email booking instructions. Captured body text and the separate walkthrough support the declared information-completion task; no booking or physical access success is inferred.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Design to assist and not to distract
guidelines.expectation: Assess visible distractions against the declared visitor task; distinguish useful prompts from interruptions.

judgments.rationale: The seven captured templates keep visitor, exhibition, editorial or policy content available. Membership, tickets and newsletter prompts are identifiable and related to the institution; the parking journey completes without a booking or modal interruption. No autoplay media is recorded. Hidden menu promotions do not establish visible distraction.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Avoid being manipulative or deceptive
guidelines.expectation: Inspect choice wording, defaults, prominence and the observed accept/reject paths for undue steering. DOM text alone does not establish visual parity.

judgments.rationale: Prices/free-for-members and booking labels are visible, and the task stays outside purchases. No cookie banner is observed in these fresh states, while the cookie policy offers Manage Preferences and third-party tracking loads. The preference manager, defaults and accept/reject routes were not exercised; neither fair consent choice nor deceptive behavior is established.
judgments.nextEvidence: Open Manage Preferences, inspect defaults and operate accept/reject routes with a visual comparison; do not interpret no observed banner as consent compliance.

guidelines.title: Make deliverables understandable and reusable
guidelines.expectation: Assess the sampled task's wording, headings and terminology for its stated audience; retain uncertainty about unrepresented users.

judgments.rationale: The gallery page explains opening times and free admission, exhibitions identify dates and ticket routes, Stories distinguishes Read/Listen/Watch, and the sustainability statement explains website-specific actions. Parking instructions include the location and advance contact details. These support the bounded English information tasks, without representative-user comprehension or clinical/physical-access claims.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Use a design system for interface consistency
guidelines.expectation: Compare repeated navigation and control names across sampled pages; consistent samples do not prove a documented design system.

judgments.rationale: The seven pages retain the same What's on, Visit, Art, Learn, Shop and membership navigation, labeled Search and footer newsletter/privacy pattern. Section headings and contextual links identify the different page purposes. This supports naming consistency, not proof of a maintained design system.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Optimize media to reduce resource use
guidelines.expectation: The sampled task images preserve useful content and provide proportionate intrinsic dimensions and delivery choices for their rendered size and pixel density. A large image is an investigation candidate until legibility and task value are checked; absent srcset alone is not a failure.

judgments.rationale: Gallery/exhibition/editorial images have strong task value. The sample uses WebP/responsive hero choices and proportionate 279–500 pixel cards, with lazy loading on listings; some homepage cards are eager. Existing dimensions are plausible at common densities, but artwork detail, all renditions and task-image quality were not visually inspected. No removal or smaller rendition is proven safe.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect representative artwork/hero rendition quality at desktop/narrow pixel densities before any image reduction.

guidelines.title: Ensure animation is proportionate and easy to control
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed animation purpose, playback controls and reduced-motion behavior. A quiet snapshot does not prove no motion occurs elsewhere.

judgments.rationale: No video or initial animation is recorded. Narrow and reduced-motion states contain eight or nine running one-iteration DIV/SPAN transitions on the shared interface, later absent in live/cold dark states. Effect properties and visibility are not captured, so these cannot establish either harmful motion or proportionate preference handling.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect the shared transition effects and visible movement while changing reduced motion and using navigation.

guidelines.title: Use optimized web typography
guidelines.expectation: Observed web fonts and variants serve the sampled content, with a declared fallback/loading strategy where needed. Do not fail a site merely for using a web font; recommend removal or subsetting only after language and readability requirements are established.

judgments.rationale: Tate regular body faces use swap with Arial/Helvetica fallbacks; light/bold variants occur where used, while several declarations remain unloaded. Icon fonts declare block, but body text has a fallback and visible controls have names in the captured sample. This meets the bounded observed typography strategy without assuming all glyph ranges are unnecessary.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Avoid unwanted notifications
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed alerts and notification permission requests for user value and choice; absence is limited to observed states.

judgments.rationale: The six information pages and cookie policy record no notification permission calls, with no visible unsolicited alert dialog. Newsletter signup is a deliberate optional action. This is limited to captured states with browser notification permission already denied.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Reduce the impact of downloadable and physical documents
guidelines.expectation: Review print layout visibility and download labels for the declared task. Fetch and inspect document content before asserting optimization or equivalence.

judgments.rationale: Print emulation removes navigation and retains main text. Tate Modern labels its map as PDF with size and offers white/yellow print and digital communication cards; the exhibition offers a large-print guide. Their contents and print pagination were not inspected. These accessibility alternatives have a clear purpose, so neither optimization nor equivalence/removal is justified from links alone.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect the map and large-print/communication-card content, their sizes and rendered output before suggesting document changes.

guidelines.title: Involve users early in the project
Audit and test for bugs or issues requiring resolution
Validate usability through testing and real-world usage
Provide cross-platform compatibility support
guidelines.expectation: The sampled core reading content and navigation remain available without JavaScript, or an explicit alternative supports the task. This bounded check does not establish no-JavaScript search, every interaction, or all browser compatibility.

judgments.rationale: Gallery, exhibition, stories and sustainability reading content remains in fresh no-JavaScript states, with expanded gallery information useful for the parking task. However the cookie-policy page loses its 24,027-character vendor/cookie list and Manage Preferences material, leaving about 1,438 characters without an explicit alternative for the declared policy-reading task. Full-sample core content therefore fails.
judgments.nextEvidence: Render the cookie inventory and a usable policy/control alternative in HTML or link an equivalent no-script document.

guidelines.title: Set goals based on performance and energy impact
Minify and remove unused code
guidelines.expectation: Use initial JS/CSS execution observations to nominate investigation targets; require representative journeys or source corroboration before recommending removal.

judgments.rationale: Shared UI/vendor, page chunks, experimentation and tracking scripts have bounded initial coverage only. Later gallery accordions, listing filters, menus and ticket paths are not comprehensively represented. Unexecuted ranges are investigation targets, not demonstrated dead code.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture representative interaction coverage and identify concrete unused modules with source or deployment corroboration.

guidelines.title: Modularize bandwidth-heavy components
guidelines.expectation: Relate initial script resources to visible components and later task needs; recommend splitting only when a component's deferred use and usable activation are corroborated.

judgments.rationale: The network already separates runtime, vendors, TateUI and page-specific modules, with additional third-party functionality. The packet does not establish each component's later need and usable activation, so further splitting or removing a component is unresolved.
judgments.nextEvidence: Trace one costly optional component from initial request to activation, retaining required gallery information and usable controls.

guidelines.title: Avoid redundancy and duplication in code
Treat third parties the same as first parties
Ensure code follows good semantic practices
guidelines.expectation: The sampled document has a meaningful language, primary heading and main region, and task controls have visible labels or an explicit naming relationship. Count/attribute presence alone does not establish semantic correctness or WCAG compliance. The sampled initial keyboard path reaches visible task navigation/controls in a meaningful order with a discernible focus indicator. A bounded Tab trace cannot establish complete keyboard support, reverse navigation, traps or screen-reader accessibility.

judgments.rationale: All seven documents declare en-GB and a main region with meaningful visible page headings. What's On and Creating a greener website use H2 rather than H1; that alone does not contradict a meaningful primary heading. Search has an ARIA name, footer email a label, filters and accordion controls visible text. This does not establish valid markup, full filter semantics or WCAG compliance.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

judgments.rationale: Initial focus traces reach meaningful primary links with solid blue outlines. The first Skip navigation snapshot has offscreen geometry (y=-42.24, height 35.20), but it was captured immediately after print-to-screen reset and Tab, without a settled frame. The packet supplies no CSS bodies or transition timing to determine whether focus later moves it onscreen. This is an unresolved indicator observation, not a persistent defect.
judgments.nextEvidence: After screen reset settles, focus the skip link and capture settled geometry/appearance; activate it and confirm the main target is reached.

guidelines.title: Defer the loading of non-critical resources
Structure metadata for machine readability
guidelines.expectation: The sampled content has a descriptive title and usable canonical metadata when applicable; declared structured-data blocks parse as JSON. Judge description and other optional metadata according to page purpose, not a mandatory-field checklist.

judgments.rationale: Each sampled document has a descriptive title and a matching usable absolute canonical. No JSON-LD blocks are declared; missing optional descriptions on several content pages are not by themselves a failure for these tasks. Full structured-data/schema coverage is outside this narrow check.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Use media queries that support sustainability goals
guidelines.expectation: The sampled page respects applicable dark/reduced-motion preferences both before navigation and when they change in-page, without losing task content. Distinguish intentional design choices and absence of applicable motion from unsupported behavior.

judgments.rationale: Task text survives desktop, live preference changes and cold dark/reduced-motion loads. The greener-website page has an intentional dark design in every state; other templates remain light, which alone does not establish a defect. Shared transitions still appear under reduced motion without enough effect information to judge applicability or response.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect the shared DIV/SPAN transition effects under reduced motion and confirm whether their movement needs suppression.

guidelines.title: Ensure layouts work for different devices and requirements
guidelines.expectation: Compare narrow and desktop task content and overflow, then exercise affected controls; width emulation alone is not real-device compatibility.

judgments.rationale: Main tasks and headings remain at 360 CSS pixels and most templates avoid overflow. The narrow cookie-policy state does overflow; long tracker/vendor tables are a plausible cause, but their boundaries and controls were not exercised. Narrow navigation and gallery controls were not tested for task completion.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect the narrow policy table/overflow and operate affected navigation and disclosure controls before classifying a layout defect.

guidelines.title: Use sustainable JavaScript and APIs
guidelines.expectation: Repeated observed API requests are justified by the sampled task and its update needs. Identify redundant-looking requests for investigation without inferring backend cost or safe removal from URL repetition alone.

judgments.rationale: The record contains experiment/geo-device lookup, analytics/advertising and listing resources, sometimes repeated with differing events. It does not establish which updates are task-required or redundant, nor whether privacy choices altered them. URL repetition cannot justify safe removal or backend-cost claims.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect initiators, event purpose and consent state for repeated third-party calls before reducing or deferring them.

guidelines.title: Use dependencies sparingly and maintain them
Include expected and beneficial files
guidelines.expectation: The sampled service exposes a discoverable, parseable carbon.txt with usable declared relationships. Missing carbon.txt is a scoped absence, not proof of high emissions or failure of the entire guideline. Judge redirects, delegation, supported versions and schema findings explicitly.

judgments.rationale: Root and well-known carbon.txt return 404; no usable header/DNS delegation or parseable document is established. This is narrow absence within discovery, not a judgment of the actual Tate website statement or emissions.
judgments.nextEvidence: If useful, expose a valid carbon.txt linked to the existing website-specific disclosure and supported relationships.

guidelines.title: Use the most efficient solution for your service
Use the latest stable language version
Reduce the number and complexity of database queries
Use sustainable hosting
guidelines.expectation: Hosting claims identify provider, service and supporting evidence with a relationship to this origin. Self-declaration without independently corroborated operational scope remains cantTell for sustainable hosting; do not set SWDM green-hosting flags from this check.

judgments.rationale: The website statement describes server electricity/cooling and digital reductions but does not identify a provider/service and independently corroborated operational hosting scope for this origin. An efficient CMS is not proof of sustainable electricity supply.
judgments.nextEvidence: Supply the hosting-service relationship and independently corroborated operational evidence for that boundary.

guidelines.title: Optimize caching and support offline access
guidelines.expectation: Reusable public scripts/styles/media expose an appropriate caching or validation policy in the sample. Distinguish dynamic/private responses and note that headers alone do not prove cache reuse or offline support.

judgments.rationale: Versioned Tate CSS/JS expose long public immutable policies plus validators; external helpers and image responses have lifetimes or validators. Short analytics/experiment policies serve different purposes. This supports the sampled public-asset policy, not measured warm reuse or offline support.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Reduce data transfer with compression
guidelines.expectation: Material sampled text assets are delivered with compression where beneficial. Do not demand compression for already-compressed images, tiny bodies or error responses without context.

judgments.rationale: Core Tate scripts/styles use gzip. On What's On, successful consenTag.js (6,565 bytes) and popup_silent.html (12,023 bytes) responses have no content-encoding. These are material third-party text assets, whereas tiny advertising responses are not a basis for failure. Achievable transfer/energy savings are unmeasured.
judgments.nextEvidence: Verify and enable beneficial compression for the consent-provider script and document, while keeping consent behavior functional.

guidelines.title: Setup necessary error pages and redirection links
Avoid maintaining unnecessary virtualized environments or containers
Use automation wisely
Define the frequency of data refreshes
Back up critical data at routine intervals
Assess the impact and requirements of data processing
Use Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) when beneficial
Ensure infrastructure fits project requirements
Store data according to the needs of your users
Have an ethical and sustainable product strategy
guidelines.expectation: For a declared sustainability commitment and period, records show accountable review, a monitored result and a resulting action or reasoned continuation over time. A published policy, named lead or future review date alone cannot pass this implementation check.

judgments.assessmentScope: Tate Digital Green Team governance for reducing the tate.org.uk website footprint over the reported 2019–2023 baseline/progress period, plus continuing actions described on the public Digital and Creating a greener website pages captured 2026-11-06. Assess accountable review, monitored result and consequent action or reasoned continuation for that web-service commitment. No organization-wide governance or unpublished meeting evidence is in scope.
judgments.rationale: Public self-report identifies the Digital Green Team, regular meetings since 2019, estimated 2019/2023 results and completed/continuing actions for this website. That is substantive operational context, but no dated review links a monitored result to a resulting decision or reasoned continuation. The scoped implementation chain remains incomplete without demanding organization-wide minutes.
judgments.nextEvidence: Provide one dated Digital Green Team review tying the website result to a chosen next action or reasoned continuation.

guidelines.title: Assign a sustainability advocate
Inform, raise awareness, and train for sustainability
Communicate the environmental impact of user choices
guidelines.expectation: Identify consequential user choices in the sample and assess whether contextual impact information is useful and supported. Do not prescribe carbon labels on every control.

judgments.rationale: Stories labels reading, audio and video and the gallery offers digital/print resources; these help format choice. The greener-website page explains a dark, image-light design, but its 70–80% OLED statement is conditioned on maximum brightness and is not a measured saving for this visit. A supported contextual comparison for users' media/print choices is not captured.
judgments.nextEvidence: Establish task-value and delivery differences for one meaningful media/document choice before adding impact guidance; avoid labels on every control.

guidelines.title: Calculate the environmental impact
Define clear organizational sustainability goals and metrics
guidelines.expectation: Published goals for the audited web service define a measurable target or direction, relevant metric and boundary, and communicate dated progress against a comparable baseline. A corporate net-zero ambition or isolated low-carbon badge cannot establish service-specific goals and progress.

judgments.assessmentScope: The tate.org.uk web service and Tate Digital Green Team commitments described in Creating a greener website: assess the stated 2019 estimated 45 tonnes CO2e baseline, reported 2023 estimated 27 tonnes CO2e result, metric/boundary comparability and ongoing reduction direction as published on 2026-11-06. Exclude Tate buildings, collection transport, commercial shop origin and total organizational emissions; published estimates are self-report, not verified measurement.
judgments.rationale: Tate publishes a website-specific reduction direction and estimated 45 tonnes CO2e in 2019 versus 27 tonnes in 2023, attributing improvement partly to the CMS. These are relevant dated metrics for the declared service, unlike corporate-only goals. However traffic boundary, model inputs and methodological comparability are not supplied; a comparable baseline/progress judgment remains unresolved. The numbers are attributed self-report, not independent verification.
judgments.nextEvidence: Publish the calculation boundary, traffic/model assumptions and method changes for the 2019 and 2023 estimates so readers can assess comparability.

guidelines.title: Validate web sustainability efforts through external verification
Support mandatory disclosures and reporting
Create one or more impact business models
Follow a product management and maintenance strategy
Implement continuous improvement procedures
Document updates and evolutions
Evaluate if a digital product or service is necessary
guidelines.expectation: For the declared visitor task and represented access constraints, inspect material accessibility, technical, geographic or fairness barriers and verify the sampled route or alternative supports task completion while preserving necessary security and safety. Do not demand removal of justified authentication or infer all-user accessibility from one successful route.

judgments.assessmentScope: Anonymous English readers using desktop Chromium with pointer input and JavaScript, 1440 by 1000 CSS pixels: start at https://www.tate.org.uk/, follow the Tate Modern gallery card, open Accessibility, and read the accessible-parking location plus advance-booking phone/email instructions. Completion is obtaining public information; no parking booking, ticket purchase, account, contact or form submission. Keyboard-only, assistive-technology, constrained-device and physical-gallery accessibility are outside this assessment scope.
judgments.rationale: The exact anonymous desktop pointer route obtains accessible-parking location and advance contact instructions without login, contact or purchase. The full text includes twelve spaces via Park Street and booking phone/email; no material barrier prevents this information task. Keyboard/assistive-technology and physical-gallery access are outside the frozen scope.
judgments.nextEvidence: No further evidence is needed for this bounded expectation; recheck after relevant changes.

guidelines.title: Provide a supplier standards of practice document
Share economic benefits
Share decision-making power with affected parties
Use Diversity, Equity, Justice, Inclusion (DEJI) practices
Promote responsible data practices
Establish responsible practices around AI and emerging or disruptive technologies
Adopt responsible financial practices
Adopt organizational philanthropy practices
Plan for a digital product or service's care and end-of-life
Repair, reuse, refurbish, recycle or reduce e-waste
Define performance, environmental, and human budgets
Use and contribute to open source
Create a business continuity and disaster recovery plan
